contacts_birthday_ranges.name: contacts_birthday_ranges
contacts_birthday_ranges.value:
("contacts"."birthday_month" is null or "contacts"."birthday_month" between 1 and 12)
          and ("contacts"."birthday_day" is null or "contacts"."birthday_day" between 1 and 31)
          and ("contacts"."birthday_year" is null or "contacts"."birthday_year" between 1000 and 9999)

daily_items_open_node_uq.name: daily_items_open_node_uq
daily_items_open_node_uq.where: "daily_items"."node_id" is not null and "daily_items"."completed_at" is null and "daily_items"."forwarded_to" is null

jobs_dates_ordered.name: jobs_dates_ordered
jobs_dates_ordered.value:
"jobs"."start_date" is null or "jobs"."end_date" is null
          or "jobs"."end_date" >= "jobs"."start_date"

nodes_start_not_before_deferred.name: nodes_start_not_before_deferred
nodes_start_not_before_deferred.value: "nodes"."target_start_date" is null or "nodes"."deferred_date" is null or "nodes"."target_start_date" >= "nodes"."deferred_date"

nodes_lifecycle_state_by_type.name: nodes_lifecycle_state_by_type
nodes_lifecycle_state_by_type.value: ("nodes"."type" = 'result_area'::node_type and "nodes"."state" is null and "nodes"."completed_at" is null and "nodes"."deferred_date" is null) or ("nodes"."type" <> 'result_area'::node_type and "nodes"."state" is not null)

residences_dates_ordered.name: residences_dates_ordered
residences_dates_ordered.value:
"residences"."moved_in" is null or "residences"."moved_out" is null
          or "residences"."moved_out" >= "residences"."moved_in"

resources_day_minutes_nonnegative.name: resources_day_minutes_nonnegative
resources_day_minutes_nonnegative.value:
"resources"."monday_minutes" >= 0 and "resources"."tuesday_minutes" >= 0
          and "resources"."wednesday_minutes" >= 0 and "resources"."thursday_minutes" >= 0
          and "resources"."friday_minutes" >= 0 and "resources"."saturday_minutes" >= 0
          and "resources"."sunday_minutes" >= 0

task_details_ordinal_range.name: task_details_ordinal_range
task_details_ordinal_range.value: recurrence_ordinal IS NULL OR recurrence_ordinal IN (1, 2, 3, 4, -1)
